svg.data-weight-note: 46 lb (20.9 kg) with two 650 W power supplies and two fan modules
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: guide Chapter 1: eighty one-GE/ten-GE SFP+ ports, 40 regular on the baseboard and 40 DWDM and ZR capable on the mezzanine (metallic grey); four 100G QSFP28 ports (light green)
svg.data-redundancy: two 1+1 power supplies and two 1+1 fan modules, all hot-swappable; the system works with a single fan failure and more than one fan failure shuts it down
